stoppingRule: Run one trial for live replay, queue scaling and offline restart per adapter. Require complete 2,000-task validation, actual writer-only TCP outage and independent reader convergence at 10 / 100 / 500 / 1,000 writes. Electric must retain its explicitly benchmark-owned SQLite cache/outbox and idempotency identities across SIGKILL. TanStack must retain every native serialized transaction and commit receipt in its live Node executor; the fake-indexeddb queue remains memory-only and restart must be unsupported for that configuration. Verify TanStack confirmed SQLite rows separately from active optimistic data. Keep native retry/upload/shape receipts, distinct processes and separate guarantee profiles. Syncular provides the shared-controller regression. Preserve failures and do not publish timing comparisons.
